items.description: The reflection on the day-open and day-close pages writes itself about a second after you stop typing, marked Saving then Saved. Pressing Back, switching tabs or closing the window no longer throws the text away.
The journal's reflection box has a height of its own now. A long entry scrolls inside it instead of stretching the open book taller and taller and pushing the page-turn buttons off-screen.
Tag Breakdown was a full day behind, so its 7-day window never included today and its Today button looked dead. It reads the same day as everything else now.

A session belongs to one tag. Tag Breakdown used to credit a session's whole duration to every tag on it, which is why its own total read 18h30m while its donut claimed 26h30m and every share was divided by the inflated sum.
Distracted per hour counts unavoidable interruptions like the rest of the app, and focus time no longer gets padded with a rest the session never recorded.
The + Stock button on an empty shelf slot opens the item editor right there instead of sending you to Settings to hunt for it.
